nodes.label: Part A — Container Format
nodes.rationale: Technical specification for the Bioshock 1 .bsm and .U package format.

nodes.label: Part B — Object Wire Format
nodes.rationale: Details the serialization of individual objects, including Vengeance headers and state frames.

nodes.label: Part C — Per-class binary layouts
nodes.rationale: Specific binary structures for UModel, UPolys, and UTexture.

nodes.label: Vengeance Engine
nodes.rationale: Irrational's fork of UE2.5 used in BioShock.

nodes.label: Bulk Data Loader (Post-load Pass)
nodes.rationale: Describes the process of loading texture mip data from .blk files into UTexture objects after property tagging.

nodes.label: FMipmap
nodes.rationale: Contains TLazyArray<BYTE> and requires placement-new to initialize vtable correctly.

nodes.label: UStaticMesh
nodes.rationale: Vengeance-specific static mesh implementation with custom serialization for sections, vertices, and UV streams.

nodes.label: ULevel
nodes.rationale: Matches UE2.5 stream format but requires selective scaffolding to prevent crashes due to Vengeance-specific actor data.

nodes.label: Light Actor
nodes.rationale: Handles property-encoding quirks between Bioshock (FloatProperty) and UE2.5 (ByteProperty) for brightness, color, and radius.

nodes.label: dyn_* Designer-placed Physics Props
nodes.rationale: Map-embedded classes requiring an offline sidecar for StaticMesh and collision property restoration.

nodes.label: Class Rollup
nodes.rationale: Mechanism to map Bioshock-specific embedded classes to UE2.5-native ancestors to allow object construction.

nodes.label: Material Flattening
nodes.rationale: Converts complex Bioshock UShader trees into primary Diffuse UTextures for the UE2.5 fixed-function renderer.

nodes.label: Type-safety Filter
nodes.rationale: Guards against virtual calls on objects where the class/vtable and memory layout are mismatched due to rollup.
